The '''jerba''' was an [[Equine/Legends|equine]] pack animal and beast of burden native to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Many jerbas were raised to produce meats, [[Milk/Legends|milk]], pelts and [[Leather/Legends|leather]].

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Equine/Legends|horse]]-like creature, the jerba was a four-legged beast of burden with a hide of long, shaggy fur and an elongated head topped by two crooked horns. Jerbas had long, hairy tails and hooved feet.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
[[File:Jerba1.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A jerba tethered near [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]].]]
Jerbas were raised by colonists on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to provide pelts, [[Leather/Legends|leather]], meat and [[Milk/Legends|milk]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] herder [[Swilla Corey]] raised jerbas, working as a ranch hand near the [[Motesta Oasis/Legends|Motesta Oasis]], and traded jerba goods at nearby farming communities. Disaster struck when a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandwhirl]] and a pack of [[Anooba/Legends|anoobas]] killed or scattered Corey's entire herd, forcing [[Gender/Legends|her]] to beg in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. There, she recognized the brand of one of her jerbas outside [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], and was informed that the creature belonged to the [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Ketwol/Legends|Ketwol]]. In fact, Ketwol had discovered and taken in several of the animals after they fled towards his ship, Swilla attempted to steal back her property, but the Pacithhip caught her in the act. The two came to an agreement. Swilla was given shelter and allowed to return to the desert with her jerbas, and often returned to visit her new friend.<ref name="Swilla DB" />

Products made with jerba hide included jerba [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Boot/Legends|boots]], worn by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] during her [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="SW VD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and jerba-skin rugs such as the one kept by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on the floor of [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|his hut]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Japor snippet/Legends|japor snippet]] necklace featured a cord made of jerba leather.<ref name="EI VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Jabba the Hutt also had a taxidermized jerba head hanging in this throne room.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Some [[Belt/Legends|belts]] and other equipment were also made with jerba leather during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Jerba belts">{{TORcite|type=item|Unidentified Jerba Leather Belt MKII|''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jerba_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Unused concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
''Jerba'' is derived from [[Djerba]], the most famous Tunisian island and the biggest North African island. (See also [[Tunisia]] for other Tunisian-inspired names.)

Two jerbas are seen near the entrance of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], and [[Deacon]] was to have kept a jerba outside [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] in one of the film's deleted scenes.<ref name="Insider 35">{{InsiderCite|35|Anchorhead: The Lost Scenes}}</ref>
